scenarios.name: Hide and restore work features in the model browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the MCAD Software displays the single-block part fixture
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
the Hide Work Features display preference is disabled
the user enables Hide Work Features in the browser display preferences
the Origin branch is absent from the model browser
the solid body and extrusion entries remain visible
the block remains visible in the same view
the user opens the browser display preferences
the user disables Hide Work Features
the Origin branch returns to the model browser collapsed
the block remains visible in the same view
